svg.text: Three waves, six streams, and what is deliberately not built
Each gap is named with what adding it would take, so promotion to production is an addition set rather than a rewrite.
Nothing in wave 2 can start until this lands
Scripts that stand up the topology
all three parallel once stream 1 lands
The importer gains a Postgres target
• Once Arina runs gcloud auth login, subsequent gcloud commands run as her. That single fact is what draws the line between these two columns.
The project id, and that billing is live
so no value is echoed into a transcript
• gcloud SDK 582.0.0 is installed at ~/google-cloud-sdk — with NO credentialed accounts.
• terraform is not installed. docker is not installed.
VPC · Serverless VPC connector · Cloud NAT
Needed before any private-IP service other than Cloud SQL, and before fixed NAT egress IPs for the Odoo droplet firewall
Needed for a public origin, WAF rules, or a custom domain with managed certs
Needed for the n8n gateway and the transactional outbox
Needed for per-user identity, the blocking function, iam_user provisioning
• Baseline 569 backend / 443 frontend (33 files) / 29 e2e. ./scripts/verify_all.sh is the authority.
• Adding tests is free. A test that must change is escalated to Arina, NEVER edited.
• If a stream cannot proceed without an edit, that stream stops and asks.
